question: How do people pay for Naive, and who pays for model use?
options: Free framework; founders bring their own AI subscription (today)
Hybrid: free framework plus a Mentura plan that includes model credits at cost plus a stated margin, with bring-your-own-key at no markup

proposed.answer: Hybrid: keep the framework free; sell Mentura as a monthly plan per business that includes model credits and allows bring-your-own-key with no token markup. Price points TBD after the h-hybrid-credits test.
options: Free framework; founders bring their own AI subscription (today)
Hybrid: free framework plus a Mentura plan that includes model credits at cost plus a stated margin, with bring-your-own-key at no markup

reasons.claim: Agents run today on the founder's own subscription through the plugin and MCP; Mentura does not run agents yet.
The repo's own runtime design recommends pass-through metered cost per organization first, BYOK later.
Hybrid pricing is the fastest-growing model among AI apps (1% to 20% of 71 apps, Oct 2024 to Oct 2026).
The closest competitor priced $20/$200 per company per month with the price returned as credits.
Token cost dominates infrastructure cost; a runaway loop spends real money, so budgets per organization are needed.
